events.title: Halloween Costume Sand Play at The Sand Garden
events.loc: The Sand Garden , 660 N.W. Gilman Blvd., C-2, Issaquah
events.desc: Have you visited Washington’s largest indoor sandbox yet? This is the perfect opportunity to visit and celebrate Halloween in one fell swoop. Kids in costume get discounted admission (and parents get free drip coffee!).

events.title: Seattle Children’s Theatre Presents ‘I’ll Be Your Superhero’
events.loc: Seattle Children’s Theatre , 201 Thomas St., Seattle
events.desc: It’s the last weekend for this inspiring production, and you don’t want to miss it! The story follows a 10-year-old boy named Xavier who moves in with his uncle. Together, they tackle big emotions and family issues. Best of all, they take a trip to the world-famous Comic Con and discover their own superpowers along the way.

events.title: Lake Stevens HarvestFest
events.loc: North Cove Park , 1806 Main St., Lake Stevens
events.desc: Put on your costumes and head to Main Street for a fun-filled Halloween fest. Kids can trick-or-treat at the booths, make arts and crafts, and even explore big rig vehicles. Balance out the inevitable sugar rush with dinner from one of the fantastic food trucks on-site.

events.title: Kirkland Catrina Walk
events.loc: Kirkland Marina Park , 25 Lakeshore Plaza Dr., Kirkland
events.desc: Día de Muertos is a beautiful celebration honoring loved ones who have passed away. Enjoy live music, cultural performances and artwork at this community fest. Then join a special procession through downtown Kirkland.

events.title: Fear on the Pier at MaST Center
events.loc: MaST Center , 28203 Redondo Beach Dr. S., Des Moines
events.desc: Did you know Des Moines is the Sixgill Shark Capital of the World? Discover more about the unique beach habitat that draws sharks in, along with other creepy, crawly sea creatures. There will be marine mammal bones, specimens and hands-on activities waiting to be discovered at this Halloween festival. (Wear your costume for a special treat!)

events.title: Spooky Skulls Walk
events.loc: Harbor Wildwatch Marine Life Center , 3207 Harborview Dr., Gig Harbor
events.desc: Spooky, scary skeletons! You’ll discover a few different animal skulls on this haunting walk along the trails. A Harbor WildWatch biologist will share fun facts about each one! Costumes are encouraged (it is Halloween, after all).

events.title: Laerke Farewell Weekend at Point Defiance Zoo & Aquarium
events.cost: Included with admission ($17–$32, ages 2 and younger free) or membership
events.loc: Point Defiance Zoo & Aquarium , 5400 N. Pearl St., Tacoma
events.desc: The Dambo trolls may have just settled in at Point Defiance Zoo, but a beloved resident is moving out. It’s polar bear Laerke’s last weekend before she heads to a new zoo. Listen to a special keeper chat, watch Laerke enjoy her favorite enrichments and bid her adieu.

events.title: Festál Series: Día de Muertos Festival
events.loc: Seattle Center Armory , 305 Harrison St., Seattle
events.desc: At this colorful and vibrant Día de Muertos festival, you can expect music and dance performances, face painting, sugar skull workshops, and stunning visual art. There will also be elaborate altars honoring ancestors.

events.title: Reign FC’s Kids 12 and Under Free
events.loc: Lumen Field , 800 Occidental Ave. S., Seattle
events.desc: It’s the last Reign match of the season, making it the last chance to snag free tickets for kids ages 12 and younger! You can get up to five free kids’ tickets with the purchase of an adult ticket. Then you’re all set to cheer on the incredible soccer team as they take on the Orlando Pride.

events.title: Aqua Run at Evans Pool
events.loc: Evans Pool , 7201 E. Green Lake Dr. N., Seattle
events.desc: Watch with coffee in hand as the kids explore a new indoor play café .
